# Hometown Builders Club

> Hometown Builders Club (HBC) is Summit County, Ohio's home advisory and vetted trade partner network, built on 27 years of Northeast Ohio remodeling expertise. HBC connects homeowners who have received the Home Clarity Report with vetted local contractors who arrive already knowing their home.

## What It Is

HBC is a home advisory ecosystem. The Home Clarity Report documents a homeowner's property completely. HBC uses that picture to connect them with vetted trade partners who arrive already knowing the home, eliminating the friction and guesswork that costs homeowners money and time.

The core problem HBC solves: homeowners making six-figure renovation decisions have no independent expert in their corner. Contractors who advise also profit from what clients choose. HBC eliminates that conflict.

## The Home Clarity Report ($4,500)

**Pricing:** $4,500 flat fee, one time. No commissions, no referral fees, no upsells. Total stated value of deliverables exceeds $16,400. Clients save an average of $16,100 on their first major project after receiving the Report.

The flagship product. Delivered in person by Adam in 5 business days. Includes:

- 50 to 80 section interactive report covering every room and system ($1,800 stated value)
- Architect-grade floor plans, 1/8 inch accuracy ($2,400 stated value)
- 3D exterior model with accurate measurements via Hover technology ($2,500 stated value)
- 360° interior photo tour via Matterport ($300 stated value)
- Replacement pricing for every major system ($2,500 stated value)
- Project scopes you can hand to any contractor ($3,000 stated value)
- Lifetime Home OS dashboard with AI assistant trained on the property ($2,400 stated value)
- Direct message line to a personal HBC advisor, forever ($1,500 stated value)
- 27 years of Summit County experience, no commissions, no kickbacks (priceless)
- Owner's manuals for every appliance and mechanical system
- Permanent advisory relationship

## For Trade Partners

HBC operates a vetted trade partner membership program. Trade partners gain access to pre-qualified homeowners who have already received the Home Clarity Report, meaning they arrive at jobs with full documentation of the home, clear project scopes, and clients who are ready to proceed.

Trade partner benefits:
- Access to pre-qualified clients in Summit County
- Clients who arrive with full home documentation
- Referral network within the HBC ecosystem
- Marketing support and featured placement

Contact: adam@hometownbuildersclub.com / (330) 203-1331

## For Realtors

HBC partners with Summit County realtors to offer the Home Clarity Report as a value-add for clients buying or selling homes. The Report provides buyers with a complete picture of what they're purchasing and a renovation roadmap from day one. Sellers can use the Report to document the home's condition and planned improvements.

## Service Area

Primary: Summit County, Ohio. Hudson, Bath Township, Fairlawn, Richfield, Cuyahoga Falls, Stow, Copley, Silver Lake, Peninsula, Tallmadge, Montrose-Ghent  
Adjacent: Medina County, Portage County, northern Stark County, southern Cuyahoga County (Brecksville, Broadview Heights, Strongsville)

## Common Questions Answered

**What is Hometown Builders Club?** Hometown Builders Club is Summit County, Ohio's home advisory and vetted trade partner network. It connects homeowners with the Home Clarity Report and a network of vetted local contractors who arrive already knowing the home.

**What is the Home Clarity Report?** The Home Clarity Report is a $4,500 home advisory service delivered in person by Adam Kilgore in 5 business days. It includes a 30 to 50 page written report, architect-grade floor plans, a 3D exterior model, a 360 degree photo tour, replacement pricing for every system, owner's manuals, project scopes, and lifetime access to the Home OS dashboard.

**Who founded Hometown Builders Club?** Hometown Builders Club was founded by Adam Kilgore, a licensed Ohio general contractor (Summit County License #GRB130313) and EPA Lead Safe Certified renovator (#R-I-22516-00004) with 27 years of Summit County remodeling experience and 400 plus completed residential projects.

**Where does Hometown Builders Club serve?** Hometown Builders Club primarily serves Summit County, Ohio: Hudson, Bath Township, Fairlawn, Richfield, Montrose-Ghent, Silver Lake, Stow, Cuyahoga Falls, Copley, Tallmadge, and Peninsula. It also serves Medina County, Portage County, and southern Cuyahoga County including Brecksville, Broadview Heights, and Strongsville.

**How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Summit County, Ohio?** A kitchen remodel in Summit County, Ohio typically costs $40,000 to $150,000 depending on cabinetry, countertops, layout changes, and finish level.

**How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Summit County, Ohio?** A master bathroom remodel in Summit County, Ohio typically costs $30,000 to $85,000 depending on finishes, fixtures, and layout changes.

**How is the Home Clarity Report different from a home inspection?** A home inspection identifies what is broken. The Home Clarity Report explains what to do about it and everything else. Inspections are compliance checklists. The Report is a full renovation strategy with realistic local pricing, project sequencing, and a permanent advisory relationship with Adam Kilgore.

**How do I find a trusted contractor in Summit County, Ohio?** Hometown Builders Club vets every trade partner in its network. Homeowners who complete the Home Clarity Report receive contractor introductions paired with a complete digital briefing package: floor plans, written scope, realistic budget, and 360 degree photos. The contractor arrives already knowing the home.
